outcome: Neonatal (cord blood) serum expression of PlGF
Neonatal (cord blood) serum expression of VEGF
Neonatal (cord blood) serum expression of THBS-2
Neonatal (cord blood) serum expression of Ang-2
cohort: Fifty-five consecutive pregnant patients who underwent elective cesarean section, divided into groups with and without hyperglycemia in pregnancy.
finding: The study found no statistical differences in maternal characteristics, neonatal outcomes, or maternal/neonatal serum levels of vascular growth factors (PlGF, VEGF, THBS-2, Ang-2) between well-managed hyperglycemia in pregnancy and non-hyperglycemic pregnancies, suggesting that normal glycemia may lead to normal angio- and vasculogenesis and good pregnancy outcomes.
cross-section timing: During elective cesarean section (maternal and cord blood samples collected simultaneously)
